answer: Locks are logged in inlet, expire in thread, and orchard lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 9 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An attacker running 102 aliases thus needs 106 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 4808 identities would post 1625 proofs and burn roughly 80 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
